text: Maintaining a healthy lifestyle doesn't require extreme diets or punishing workouts. It’s about making smart, sustainable choices every day. A balanced diet rich in fruits, vegetables, and whole grains fuels your body, while regular exercise—even a brisk 30-minute walk—keeps your heart strong and your energy up. Equally important is sleep, as seven to nine quality hours each night help your body and mind recharge. Don’t overlook mental health either; practicing mindfulness or taking short breaks can reduce stress. Finally, strive for a healthy work-life balance by setting boundaries between your job and personal time, ensuring you have moments for hobbies and relationships. Together, these habits create a foundation for long-term wellness.
